import { createContextKey, declareExtern, definePrototype, tw } from '@proto.ui/core/authoring';

export const ITEM_ZONE = createContextKey<string>('keyed-item-zone');

const loadItem = declareExtern<[id: string], string>({
  name: 'fixture.load-keyed-item',
  effect: 'after-state-commit',
  lifetime: 'task',
  async: true,
  targets: ['react', 'gpui'],
});

export const KeyedTaskItem = definePrototype({
  name: 'keyed-task-item',
  setup(def) {
    const props = def.props.define({ id: { type: 'string', default: '' } });
    const zone = def.context.consume(ITEM_ZONE);
    const initialZone = def.state.define<string>('initialZone', { initialize: read => read.get(zone) });
    const answer = def.state.define<string>('answer', { initialize: () => 'pending' });
    const load = def.task<[], void>('load', { policy: 'latest' }, async task => {
      const id = task.get(props.id);
      const startedIn = task.get(zone);
      const text = await task.await(loadItem, id);
      task.set<string>(answer, text + '@' + startedIn + '>' + task.get(zone));
    });
    const start = def.action<[], void>('start', run => { run.start(load); });
    def.lifecycle.onCreated(start);
    def.expose.state('initialZone', initialZone);
    def.expose.state('answer', answer);
    const label = def.derive('label', read =>
      read.get(props.id) + ':' + read.get(initialZone) + '/' + read.get(zone) + '/' + read.get(answer));
    return view => view.el('span', { style: tw('keyed-task-item') }, [view.get(label)]);
  },
});

export default definePrototype({
  name: 'keyed-task-owner',
  setup(def) {
    const props = def.props.define({
      first: { type: 'string', default: 'A' },
      second: { type: 'string', default: 'B' },
    });
    return view => view.el('div', {}, [
      view.child(KeyedTaskItem, { key: view.get(props.first), props: { id: view.get(props.first) } }),
      view.child(KeyedTaskItem, { key: view.get(props.second), props: { id: view.get(props.second) } }),
    ]);
  },
});
